name: io.github.ohneben/wafeq-mcp
description: Wafeq MCP server — all 251 API endpoints generated from the OpenAPI spec as safety-categorized tools (Docker + Streamable HTTP).

environment_variables.name: WAFEQ_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: Private organization API key, sent as `Authorization: Api-Key <key>`. Wafeq → Settings → Developer → API keys.

environment_variables.name: WAFEQ_ACCESS_TOKEN
environment_variables.description: OAuth2 app access token, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Use instead of WAFEQ_API_KEY.

environment_variables.name: MCP_SHARED_TOKEN
environment_variables.description: Optional bearer token required on the /mcp endpoint. Empty = open (bind to localhost only).

environment_variables.name: WAFEQ_TOOL_GROUPS
environment_variables.description: Comma-separated resource groups to expose (e.g. invoices,bills,reports). Empty exposes all 251 generated tools.

environment_variables.name: WAFEQ_API_BASE_URL
environment_variables.description: Override the Wafeq API base URL. Defaults to https://api.wafeq.com/v1
